what_broke: HMR crash in release: `Cannot destructure property 'isLikelyComponentType'`
root_cause: side effect (`insert_stale`) inside `debug_assert!` is not executed in release; Zig `assert` is a function and always runs its argument
no comptime: `Output::pretty` rewrites `<r>` markers inside substituted arguments

what_broke: `bun build --compile` + `bun:ffi dlopen()` of an embedded library fails
root_cause: port shipped a stub where Zig materialized the embedded library
template copied byte-by-byte via `b as char` (UTF-8 read as Latin-1)
argon2 implementation replaced; port silently clamps m<8 and never recorded it

what_broke: `bun run build` with empty script exits 0 instead of 1
root_cause: helper drops only empty keys; Zig also dropped empty values

what_broke: `Blob.text()` on UTF-16 BOM + odd byte count panics
root_cause: Zig `@divTrunc` dropped the trailing byte; `bytemuck::cast_slice` panics
identifier formatter no longer prefixes `_` before a digit
placeholder block size (64 vs 2048) left by the port; Rust bounds check turned a silent out-of-bounds write (unchecked in Zig ReleaseFast) into a panic

what_broke: SQL: columns like `2024_01` become indexes, named keys lost
root_cause: column-name classification lost in the port
port deliberately normalizes a scratch copy instead of mutating in place; not recorded
use-after-free: ownership of PackageJSON changed in the port

what_broke: resolver panics on `C:/` or a file directly in `/`
root_cause: Zig `assertf` stripped in release; Rust `assert!` always runs
Zig used BoringSSL RAND_bytes; port calls getrandom directly
bug in the ported JSON lexer

what_broke: `fs.watch` on macOS segfaults when closed from a callback
root_cause: aliased `&mut` across threads (UB absent in Zig)
port prints the enum variant name instead of Zig `@tagName`
